body:

Pantai
The reason you were temp-banned/banned
Advertising I think
Why you should be unbanned from the server.
I regret what I did but it's not my fault in some way. So, thing is, I was talking to Juano and DaGoldBrick over Skype, then we decided to get on Badlion for some 1v1s and that's when Brick accused me of hacking. I obviously don't hack so I told him to join join.me for me to show him I didn't hack, Juano joined as well. But something I didn't pay attention to was that I was having doritos at that time and you won't believe me but I actually get diarrea from them. I hoped on my bathroom as soon as I could and in the meantime, Brick advertised on purpose for me to get banned. I think he was salty about me being better than him but I'm not sure. Pretty sure Juano wasn't paying attention to my screen so he didn't notice when Brick wrote the thingy. Oh and I forgot to tell you, I gave perms to Brick so he could check my files and control my PC.
